ResearchTabDef.label: GeneFoundry
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: After researching xenogenetics, gene fabrication unlocks biomass extraction, refinement and gene manufacturing. Enzymatic extraction improves recovery. Gene category projects follow gene fabrication; archite genes also require vanilla archogenetics.

ResearchProjectDef.label: enzymatic extraction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Use herbal medicine as a catalyst to improve biomass recovery from meat, plants and organic corpses. Corpse catalyst costs scale with body material; all decay stages can be processed.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gene fabrication
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock gene vats and basic biomass extraction, refineries and raw biomass hoppers, and the foundation for fabricating genes from refined biomass. All cosmetic categories are automatically researched at no additional cost. Other gene categories require independent research. Completing a category permits fabrication of all of its genes; genes with an archite cost also require vanilla archogenetics, including cosmetic genes. Category costs depend on gene count, total complexity and total archite value. Configure research costs in GeneFoundry's Gene research settings, then restart RimWorld.
